title: Fourier weight at successive odd dimensions
statement: Let $m$ and $j$ be nonnegative integers with $j\le m$. The level-$(2j+1)$ Fourier weight of majority on the Boolean cube of dimension $2m+3$ equals $\frac{(2m+3)(2(m-j)+1)}{(2m+2)(2(m-j)+2)}$ times its level-$(2j+1)$ Fourier weight on the Boolean cube of dimension $2m+1$.
